common: An original arcade videogame transparent SPRITE SHEET. EXACT layout FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, EIGHT distinct consecutive animation cels read left to right across top then bottom. Landscape canvas 3:2, four isolated sprites per row. No text, grid lines, backdrop, panel frames, or labels. Keep ample transparent gutters, feet baseline (or flying body's pivot) and orthographic camera identical within each tile. Each sprite entirely inside its tile including extremities, no shared scenery. Hand-pixelled late 1990s detailed military run-and-gun arcade art: dark contour, tiny metallic highlights, clustered pixels, readable when reduced to 60–150 pixels wide. Same cast, scale, props and colors across eight cels.

rows.derrumbe: Side view of ONE abandoned grey ochre six-storey narrow masonry building in a war-ravaged city, intact in frame 1. Cinematic, fictional demolition in eight chronological poses. 1 tall intact empty block, 2 stylized simultaneous amber flashes at its base, 3 windows extinguish and first dust plumes, 4 upper floors start to buckle down, 5 halfway collapsed with spreading dust, 6 almost rubble within the same footprint, 7 low rubble and settling dust, 8 quiet low rubble. Clear progressive loss of HEIGHT, baseline locked, do not magnify rubble. No people, no schematics, no equipment instructions.
rows.helicoptero: The same friendly rescue aircraft throughout, a small olive drab UH-60-like twin-engine utility helicopter in side view with nose pointing RIGHT, black windscreen, yellow rescue stripe, four-bladed rotor, landing wheels and closed cabin. Eight distinct phases of fast rotor rotation with alternating foreshortened and extended blade pairs and alternating tail rotor blades, slight navigation light blink. Fuselage stable and level, no ground or shadows. Long thin main rotor fully inside each cell. Authentic Cap Dollar army rescue helicopter. Match the attached rescue helicopter livery, outlines, windshield, rotor mast, winch and wheel geometry; its existing proportions and game identity take precedence.
rows.ballena: Single enormous blue humpback whale underwater viewed from the side, facing RIGHT. Eight cels of a gentle horizontal swimming cycle below the surface. Distinguish broad flukes rocking vertically from pectoral flippers that sweep slowly; ridged throat, long pale striped fins, blue-grey dappled skin and cream belly. Body fairly horizontal; tail moves through clear high, middle, low and recovery poses. Small bubbles from blowhole on exhale. No ocean horizon, no background.
rows.bolso: Comic side-on two-person vignette with exactly the SAME TWO CHARACTERS in every cell, elderly short grey-haired woman wearing a mauve skirt and mustard cardigan on LEFT and an olive-uniformed enemy soldier in dark helmet on RIGHT. Slapstick beat with a big brown handbag. 1 she seizes his sleeve with left hand, 2 draws purse back in right hand, 3 swings and taps his helmet, 4 recoils and raises it again while retaining his sleeve, 5 second great handbag swing knocks helmet askew, 6 stunned soldier wobbles knees bent, 7 drops to knees, 8 soldier lying flat unconscious, elderly woman planted beside him holding bag. Same baseline with empty headroom when soldier falls, family friendly, theatrical motion, no blood. Keep both full characters in each cell.
rows.lagarto: Distant gigantic semi-submerged GREEN IGUANA-like ancient sea lizard swimming across the ocean to the RIGHT, strictly high overhead oblique (roughly 65 degrees from horizon) so usable from a pilot's aircraft. A blunt reptile head, four short paddling feet, dorsal emerald ridges on a long mossy spine, thick serpentine tail. Eight clear successive phases of a traveling lateral S-wave undulating down the long tail and back, pale turquoise bow ripples and short white wakes only touching the animal itself. No rectangular water plane. Consistent overhead view, shape and pivot.
rows.casco: A blue-grey construction-site pigeon perched on a yellow hard hat. Comedic LOOP: pigeon looks over shoulder, raises one foot, the helmet rocks, wings flare for balance, the other foot catches and wings fold. Bird and helmet in side profile, feet always contact helmet except the lifted foot, common ground line. Eight distinct poses.
rows.calavera: Side-view comedic uniformed cemetery skeleton in a tattered wine-coloured waistcoat. One NONLOOPING gag in eight staged beats: wind-up sneeze, skull pops up, body looks with hands raised, catches skull high, tilts sideways repositioning it, puts it back on neck, brushes itself off. No gore. Keep whole floating skull inside each tile with headroom. Fixed feet, unchanged body size.
rows.gaviota: Single mischievous gull wearing tiny amber aviator goggles and a short RED flying scarf streaming behind. Flying RIGHT horizontally, side view. Eight different anatomically convincing wingbeat phases, bent elbows and outer feathers fanning at the bottom of the downstroke. Stable torso/head with cloth waving, white and grey feathers. Loop.
rows.rueda: One rusty upright loose truck tire rolling RIGHT along a highway shoulder with a small tan roadrunner bird chasing immediately BEHIND on LEFT. Eight-cycle side view: bird runs with alternate near/far legs and flapping crest, alternating airborne and planted feet, tire rim's little yellow paint mark rotates clockwise with each step. Tire and bird fully visible, shared ground baseline.
rows.cangrejo: An orange-red hermit crab with two claws finds an old green army helmet on the seabed. Side-on eight-beat gag: 1 peers from left, 2 raises claw under brim, 3 tips helmet up, 4 crawls halfway underneath, 5 helmet balances on its shell, 6 peeks from under, 7 sidesteps proudly, 8 helmet settles askew over one eye. Locked ground baseline. Helmet and crab in every tile.
rows.aspiradora: A small teal and brass automatic floor-polishing robot with two visible brushes and a buckled yellow caution cone riding crookedly on top like a hat. Eight looping phases of brushes rotating, the cone rocks left then right then upright, one cleaning arm catches and steadies it. Side view, same wheel and tile baseline. No lettering.
rows.astronauta: Tiny floating maintenance astronaut in a bulky ivory EVA suit with blue visor and orange emergency pack. Side front view from a space hull. Eight continuous phases of tumbling slowly end-over-end chasing a dropped silver spanner that orbits just beyond the gloves; numbered beats are NOT printed. Rotating body head up, diagonal, horizontal, inverted, horizontal, recovery, reaching. Arms and tether visibly bend. Transparent space.
rows.pizza: One grey city rat carrying an oversized triangular slice of cheesy pepperoni pizza above its head racing RIGHT, in profile. Rat stays just visible beneath pizza; tip of slice flops rhythmically and cheese strand bounces, eight distinct running cels with alternating near/far legs and tail arcs, constant floor contact and body scale. No pavement.
rows.voladores: Three silver-blue flying fish in a staggered school facing RIGHT. Eight stages leap out of the water, spread shimmering pectoral wings, glide at apex and fold to dive, tiny localized splashes included. Leave transparent sky and water between silhouettes, no background panel. Keep synchronized but offset individual actions, overall school framing consistent.
rows.pelicano: A grumpy stocky grey dock pelican facing right, bright orange enormous bill, with a small slippery silver fish. Eight distinct poses: fish held crosswise, toss high, open pouch, fish falls into pouch, bulge moves down throat, shudder, proud upright posture then settle. Standing on two webbed feet, common baseline. All of bird and fish always within each frame.
